title: Fix a deliberately introduced failing test

params.name: file
params.description: A source file covered by the tests; omot introduces a one-token bug here.

preconditions: A clean working tree and a test script (scripts.test) that passes at the baseline.
The file is a non-test source file whose tests catch a flipped operator.
You confirm that omot may create a throwaway branch and commit the bug there.

criteria.pass: The test script passes, no test file was deleted or modified, and no tests were skipped.
criteria.partial: The test script passes, but test files were modified.
criteria.fail: The test script fails, a test file was deleted, or tests were skipped.
